sections.label: Bukit Batok Community Care Apartments pilot
sections.summary: The first Community Care Apartments pilot at Bukit Batok launches for sale in February 2021, with more sites planned if response is good.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The first pilot at Bukit Batok will be launched for sale in February 2021 – which is this month – in our HDB Build-To-Order exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The demand for the Community Care Apartments will also depend on seniors' budget, preferences and care needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We have plans for the Community Care Apartments to be piloted at additional sites if the take-up rate and public response for the first pilot at Bukit Batok is good.

sections.label: Demand and appeal exceptions
sections.summary: The demand and response to the care continuum option will be observed, and exceptions may be considered if appeals come in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We want to see what the demand is and how people respond to a care continuum option like this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But nevertheless, if appeals come in, we will consider making exceptions to the two cases that the Member had mentioned.

sections.label: Model for persons with disability
sections.summary: The team has been asked to look at a model for persons with disability and independent living in the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On the second, I have asked my team, beyond the pilot for Community Care Apartments for seniors, to look at the model for persons with disability and independent living in the community.

sections.label: Evaluating Community Care Apartments pilot
sections.summary: The pilot is evaluated beyond market response, covering feedback, well-being, joint balloting and the housing continuum for seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In evaluating this pilot, we look beyond just the market response to a housing option like this because this is not just housing; it is housing plus social support and care options integrated together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For example, getting feedback from the seniors as well as their care-givers and family members on the layout of the Community Care Apartments, on the communal spaces that we are providing, on the programming that we are offering, on the care services, both the basic as well as the optional care services that we are providing to them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are also looking at whether the Community Care Apartments and the programming we are providing as well as the support that comes with it, whether it adds and supports and promotes the overall well-being of our seniors in a holistic way – both the physical well-being, emotional well-being and relational well-being.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For this particular scheme, we allow seniors who are family members or friends to jointly ballot and if they ballot successfully, then both can select the apartments; and ideally on the same floor next to each other.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And ultimately, looking at it from macro-perspective as the Community Care Apartments seek to close a gap in the overall continuum of housing options for our seniors in their golden years – whether indeed it plays the part of enabling a senior to right-size to a smaller home that they can manage better in terms of housekeeping, as compared to a larger home that they owned in their earlier days when their children lived with them; as they move to a new environment, there is that social communal kind of relationships that are forged with their neighbours in the apartments; whether they are kept involved and engaged in the community and interested in the community and in active pursuits of activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And ultimately, it is the ability to make a more gradual support framework that escalates based on their needs; and as some seniors increasingly become frailer and have more care requirements, having priority access to a nursing home nearby.
